replies.message: Hi Kaitlin Gordeyko this workflow will not be possible. For the Walmart cards they will need to first create a file that they will need to upload into Fiserve, which will create the cards. At that point they will be able to add the cards into the card vault to allocate to an order.

Tim do you mean we cannot have things auto filled in, or we cannot have this card preparation piece right on the page? (this is where they would be creating that file to upload to Fiserve ideally rather than be taken to a new page to do so)

Kaitlin Gordeyko Right now it shows them being generated inline and that isn't possible. Likely there will be more fields required to create the cards than what is shown as well so I think it is better to have them taken to a new page. Some of the values could potentially be pre-filled, but we will not send them to the site as the design says "You will be taken to Fiserve...". The only thing our app will do is allow them to download the file they need for Fiserve and then allow them to add the cards back into the app.

The description line can easily be changed to match accurate information! Do you know how many more fields there will be? We're just going off the prototype. But if it's not possible, it's not possible. LMK if you want to chat about this in a meet Tim

No I don't know how many fields there will be. For functionality sake, lets keep it a separate screen. There is already a lot going on on the individual order pages. Generating the Walmart card generation file would be too much I think.
